scope: Simulates all 18 family members (3 put modes x 3 channel modes x 2 trigger states) against calibration receipts, then predicts the goal only if all consistent candidates agree.
lesson: The channel is main changes() (last direct row-change count), not total_changes, and put uses INSERT OR IGNORE: repeated put of same key yields channel 2 (1+1) but committed_sum 1. Trigger absent.
